content: On the Hour, Level Two (dialectical theologians, those who rely on reason) hold that God is an entirely free agent who can reassemble the dispersed atoms and recreate the same person, answering the philosophers' objection that what has ceased to be cannot be again; some theologians hold that restoring only the original bodily parts suffices.
refers_to_primary: Ibn Turka, R. Shaqq-i Qamar u Bayān-i Sāʿat
